user.title: Connect Belgee X50
user.description: Prepare a protected X50 Relay connection to Home Assistant.

data_description.installation_id: Do not use an IP address. This ID separates the real head unit from AVD installations.
data_description.public_base_url: Externally reachable base URL, for example https://ha.example.com. A local 192.168.x.x address will not work outside your home network.

pair.title: Pair X50 Relay
pair.description:
Open “Connect to Home Assistant” in Relay. HA address: `{public_base_url}`

One-time code:

## `{pairing_code}`

The code is valid for {expires_minutes} minutes. After entering it in Relay, select Check.

pair_confirm.title: Confirm Relay
pair_confirm.description:
Found **{device_name}**, version `{relay_version}`.

Compare the fingerprint shown in Relay:

## `{fingerprint}`

Confirm only when both values match.

error.invalid_public_url: Enter a complete public URL starting with http:// or https://, without a query or fragment.
error.relay_not_connected: Relay has not claimed this code yet. Enter it in Relay and check again.

abort.pairing_expired: The pairing code expired. Start pairing again.

data.start_pairing: Create a code to pair or re-pair Relay

data_description.public_base_url: The Home Assistant address reachable by Relay.
data_description.start_pairing: The existing Bearer token is replaced automatically after confirmation.
